column2: The qualifying-service rule: qualifying service begins from{{c1::taking charge of the first post}}— with which 2 provisos and 1 exception?
column3:
Rule: P1: officiating/temporary service followed by substantive appointment counts. P2: no service before age 18 counts. Exception: military counting counting.

Hinglish: Pehle post ka charge = shuruaat; 18 se pehle ka zero; officiating→substantive judta hai.

Ref: Rule 11; Rule 20
column5: CCS_Pension Rule_11 Qualifying_Service Proviso CCS_Pension::Rule_11 Priority::High

column2: The qualifying-service rule's Second Proviso: service before age{{c1::18 years}}does NOT count — but verification timeline clock ALSO starts at{{c2::18 years}}of service. Avoid the confusion.
column3:
Rule: 18 YEARS OF AGE (the qualifying-service rule floor) vs 18 YEARS OF SERVICE (verification trigger) — same number, different units.

Hinglish: 18 saal UMAR vs 18 saal NAUKRI — sankhya ek, matlab alag.

Trap: Units trap.

Ref: Rule 11; Rule 30(1); Rule 30

column2: The paid-service rule: service counts only if the servant performed{{c1::duties AND drew pay}}— state the Explanation's funding test.
column3:
Rule: Service under Government + paid from Consolidated Fund of India / Govt-administered Local Fund; non-contributory-scheme service excluded unless Government orders otherwise (override).

Hinglish: Kaam + tankhvah dono; paisa Sarkari khazane se; non-contributory scheme bahar (Sarkar chahe to andar).

Ref: Rule 12
column5: CCS_Pension Rule_12 Qualifying_Service Explanation CCS_Pension::Rule_12 Priority::High

column2: The State-transfer rule's sub-rule (1):{{c1::permanent transfer}}to State service preserves counting; the State-transfer rule's sub-rule (3):{{c2::Central Government bears}}the pension liability.
column3:
Rule: Centre-to-State permanent transferees keep QS; Centre pays (liability allocation rule).

Hinglish: Rajya me pakke transfer par service bachi; kharcha Kendra dega.

Ref: Rule 13(1), 13(3); Rule 13(1); Rule 13(3)

column2: The PSU-counting rule's sub-rule (1)all 4 clauses: counting PSU-era service needs which 4 conditions?
column3:
Rule: prior Govt service linkage proper-channel absorption/permission lump-sum refund (pension/service gratuity + retirement gratuity) commutation under CCS (Commutation) Rules 1981 Table. the PSU-counting rule's sub-rule: PSU exclusion fence.

Hinglish: Link + permission + paisa wapas + 1981 Table = PSU service gini.

Ref: Rule 14(1)(a)-(d), 14(3); Rule 14(1); Rule 14(a)-(d); Rule 14(3); Rule 14(a); Rule 14(b); Rule 14(c); Rule 14(d)
column5: CCS_Pension Rule_14 Qualifying_Service PSU CCS_Pension::Rule_14 Priority::High

column2: The PSU-counting rule's sub-rule (1)(c) lump sum ={{c1::pension/service gratuity + retirement gratuity}}already drawn; PSU-counting commutation follows the{{c2::1981 Table}}.
column3:
Rule: Refund what you took; commute only per CCS (Commutation of Pension) Rules 1981 Table.

Hinglish: Jo liya wapas karo; commutation 1981 Table se.

Ref: Rule 14(1)(c), 14(1)(d); Rule 14(1)

column2: The temporary-status rule: regularised{{c1::temporary-status}}(Casual Labourers Scheme 1993, DoPT) service counts at{{c2::family-pension per cent}}.
column3:
Rule: Only REGULARISATION unlocks the 50%; casual spell itself never counts directly.

Hinglish: Regular ho gaye to aadhi service mili — Casual Labourers Scheme 1993 walo ko.

Ref: Rule 15; Rule 2 Expl.4; Rule 50
column5: CCS_Pension Rule_15 Qualifying_Service Threshold CCS_Pension::Rule_15 Priority::High

column2: The probation rule:{{c1::probation}}against a post counts once followed by{{c2::confirmation}}(same or another post).
column3:
Rule: Probation + confirmation = qualifying; unconfirmed probation dangling alone is the risk case.

Hinglish: Pariksha-kaalin service pakki niyukti ke saath gini.

Ref: Rule 16

column2: The apprenticeship rule:{{c1::apprentice}}service is EXCLUDED — except{{c2::SAS apprentices of IA&AD / DAD only}}.
column3:
Rule: General apprentice ban; narrow SAS (Subordinate Accounts Service) exception in audit/defence accounts.

Hinglish: Apprentice bahar — sirf Audit/Defence Accounts ke SAS apprentice andar.

Ref: Rule 17

column2: The contract-service rule's sub-rule (i): contract appointment{{c1::on or before 31.12.2003}}can count; the contract-service rule's sub-rule (ii):{{c2::CPF Government contribution}}must be refunded (cumulative).
column3:
Rule: Pre-cutoff contract service is countable; CPF employer money comes back with accumulations.

Hinglish: 2003 tak ka contract gina; CPF ka Sarkari hissa byaaj samet wapas.

Trap: Previous SANCTION vs previous KNOWLEDGE — sanction is the load-bearing word.

Ref: Rule 18(i), 18(ii); Rule 18(i); Rule 18(ii)

column2: The civil-return rule's sub-rule (1) covers 4 re-employment entry classes:{{c1::compensation pension, invalid pension, compensation gratuity, invalid gratuity}}— which 2 pensions are NOT covered?
column3:
Rule: SUPERANNUATION and RETIRING pensions are NOT civil-return cases (their holders re-employed differently).

Hinglish: Compensation/invalid wale andar; superannuation/retiring wale bahar.

Trap: Superannuation/retiring pension = NOT the civil-return rule.

Ref: Rule 19(1); Rule 19
column5: CCS_Pension Rule_19 Re_Employment Exam_Trap CCS_Pension::Rule_19 Priority::Critical

column2: The civil-return rule refund items:{{c1::pension drawn + commutation value + retirement/service gratuity}}; instalments capped at{{c2::36 months}}; right revives ONLY on{{c3::full refund}}.
column3:
Rule: Civil Return rule: 36-monthly-instalment cap; first instalment timing fixed; part refund = no revival. the civil-return rule's sub-rule: death before full refund → adjust from death gratuity.

Hinglish: Jo liya sab wapas (36 kishton me); poora wapas tabhi purani service judegi; maut ho to death gratuity se kaato.

Ref: Rule 19(3), 19(4); Rule 19; Rule 19(3); Rule 19(4)
column5: CCS_Pension Rule_19 Re_Employment Timeline CCS_Pension::Rule_19 Priority::Critical

column2: The civil-return rule's sub-rule (2)(i):{{c1::pre-re-employment pension}}is NOT refundable; the civil-return rule's sub-rule (2)(ii):{{c2::gratuity element in pay fixation}}IS refundable.
column3:
Rule: Pension earned BEFORE re-employment stays yours; but gratuity baked into re-employed pay must return.

Hinglish: Pehle ki pension tumhari; vetan me ghusi gratuity wapas.

Ref: Rule 19(2)(i), 19(2)(ii); Rule 19(2)

column2: The civil-return rule's sub-rule (5) LIMITS the later civil pension, but military-counting imposes{{c1::NO limitation}}— state the contrast and its logic.
column3:
Rule: Civil re-employment caps the combined outcome; military re-employment lets the later civil pension run free — ex-servicemen advantage.

Hinglish: Civil wapas-noukri me seema; fauji wapas-noukri me khuli pension.

Ref: Rule 19(5); Rule 20(5); Rule 19; Rule 20
column5: CCS_Pension Rule_19 Rule_20 Comparison CCS_Pension::Rule_19 Priority::Critical

column2: The military-counting rule's sub-rule (1): military re-employment refund ={{c1::military pension drawn + its commutation value + gratuities}}; instalments{{c2::36 months}}(the military-counting rule's sub-rule (2)).
column3:
Rule: Same 36-month cap as the civil-return rule's sub-rule; the military-counting rule's sub-rule: interruption condonation deemed included.

Hinglish: Fauji pension/gratuity wapas (36 kisht); toota-link muaaf maana.

Ref: Rule 20(1), 20(2), 20(4); Rule 20(1); Rule 20(2); Rule 19(3); Rule 20(4); Rule 20(3)
column5: CCS_Pension Rule_20 Military_Service Timeline CCS_Pension::Rule_20 Priority::High

column2: The military-counting rule's Explanation 1(ii) 2022 REVERSAL: 'was NOT required to be refunded' became '{{c1::WAS TO BE REFUNDED}}'.
column3:
Rule: G.S.R. 770(E) flipped the refund duty — single-word reversal with full arithmetic consequence.

Hinglish: 2022 me 'wapas NAHI' ulta ho kar 'wapas KARO' ban gaya.

Trap: Pre-2022 vs post-2022 opposite answers.

Ref: Rule 20 Expl.1(ii) as amended; Rule 20
column5: CCS_Pension Rule_20_Exp1_ii GSR_770_E_2022 Amendment Reversal CCS_Pension::Rule_20 Priority::Critical CCS_Pension::Rule_20_Exp1_ii

column2: The military-counting rule's Explanation 2 (opt to KEEP military pension) →{{c1::military service NOT counted}}; Explanation 3 (joined AFTER 31.12.2003) →{{c2::NPS Rules apply}}.
column3:
Rule: Keep the fauji pension = lose the counting; post-cutoff joiners are NPS persons.

Hinglish: Fauji pension rakhi to service gayi; 2003 ke baad aaye to NPS.

Ref: Rule 20 Expl.2, Expl.3; Rule 20

column2: Master comparison: Civil Return vs Military Counting
column3:
Rule: civil return (compensation/invalid only; 36-mo; civil-return caps later pension) vs military counting (all military pensioners; 36-mo; military-counting deemed condonation; NO cap) + 2022 Exp.1 reversal.

Hinglish: Civil-seema vs Fauji-khula — 36 kisht dono me.

Ref: Rules 19, 20; Rule 19; Rules 20; Rule 19(5); Rule 20; Rule 20(4); Rule 20(5)
column5: CCS_Pension Rule_19 Rule_20 Comparison CCS_Pension::Rule_19 Priority::Critical

column2: The leave-counting rule 's 3 leave categories: (i){{c1::leave with leave salary — always counts}}; second,{{c2::EOL on medical grounds — always counts}}; third,{{c3::other EOL — counts ONLY on 2 grounds}}.
column3:
Rule: Grounds for: civil commotion OR higher scientific/technical studies — nothing else.

Hinglish: Tankhvah wali chhutti + bimaari wali EOL = pakka count; baaki EOL sirf danga/padhai par.

Ref: Rule 21(i)-(iii); Rule 21; Rule 21(iii)

column2: Other EOL counts ONLY for{{c1::civil commotion}}or{{c2::higher scientific/technical studies}}— apply to study leave for an MBA abroad.
column3:
Rule: MBA abroad is higher study but NOT scientific/technical → does NOT count. A PhD in physics would count.

Hinglish: MBA-videsh = nahi ginega; physics-PhD = ginega.

Ref: Rule 21(iii)
column5: CCS_Pension Rule_21 Scenario Application CCS_Pension::Rule_21 Priority::High

column2: The leave-counting rule's Explanation: leave needs a{{c1::definite service-book entry}}; late entry allowed till{{c2::6 months before superannuation}}; default favours the{{c3::employee}}.
column3:
Rule: No entry → Government proves otherwise; silence benefits the servant.

Hinglish: Entry pakki karo; der ho to retirement se 6 mahine pehle tak; shak ka fayda karmchari ko.

Ref: Rule 21 Explanation; Rule 21
column5: CCS_Pension Rule_21 Explanation Timeline CCS_Pension::Rule_21 Priority::High

column2: The training/joining rule's sub-rule (1): pre-appointment departmental training counts for{{c1::Group C}}(on pay/stipend/nominal allowance); the training/joining rule's sub-rule (2): other cases need{{c2::Government order}}.
column3:
Rule: Group C training auto-counts; everyone else needs an express Govt order.

Hinglish: Group C ki training pakki; baakiyon ko Sarkari order chahiye.

Ref: Rule 22(1), 22(2); Rule 22(1); Rule 22(2)

column2: The training/joining rule's sub-rule (3):{{c1::joining-time gap}}counts; the training/joining rule's sub-rule (4): EXCESS joining time →{{c2::leave due, else HoD-sanctioned EOL}}— and THIS EOL counts (contrast the leave-counting rule).
column3:
Rule: The training/joining eol is a deemed-count exception to the leave-counting rule's strict EOL gate.

Hinglish: Zyada joining-time = chhutti/EOL me badlo, aur ve gini jaayegi — leave-counting ka ulta.

Ref: Rule 22(3), 22(4); Rule 22(3); Rule 22(4); Rule 21

column2: The suspension rule's sub-rule (1) suspension counts ONLY if TWO limbs meet:{{c1::fully exonerated OR only minor penalty}}AND{{c2::suspension wholly unjustified}}.
column3:
Rule: BOTH needed — exoneration alone is insufficient if suspension was justified.

Hinglish: Bari + suspension be-wajah — dono shart; ek se kaam nahi.

Trap: AND, not OR, between the limbs.

Ref: Rule 23(1)
column5: CCS_Pension Rule_23 Qualifying_Service Exam_Trap CCS_Pension::Rule_23 Priority::Critical

column2: The suspension rule's sub-rule (2): counting needs an{{c1::express declaration at the time}}; the suspension rule's sub-rule (3):{{c2::every case}}gets an order + definite service-book entry.
column3:
Rule: No retrospective assumption — declare then, enter always.

Hinglish: Usi waqt ghoshna, har case me entry — baad me maan nahi liya jaata.

Ref: Rule 23(2), 23(3); Rule 23(2); Rule 23(3)

column2: The forfeiture rule:{{c1::dismissal or removal}}forfeits past service —{{c2::compulsory retirement}}is NOT in the forfeiture rule.
column3:
Rule: Dismissal/removal = forfeit (compassionate allowance may still rescue); compulsory retirement keeps pension under the compulsory-retirement rule.

Hinglish: Barkhastagi = seva zabt; compulsory retirement = pension bachi (the compulsory-retirement rule).

Trap: Compulsory retirement ≠ the forfeiture rule.

Ref: Rule 24; Rules 40, 41; Rule 41; Rule 40
column5: CCS_Pension Rule_24 Forfeiture Exam_Trap CCS_Pension::Rule_24 Priority::Critical

column2: The reinstatement rule's sub-rule (1): dismissal/removal/COMPULSORY RETIREMENT +{{c1::reinstatement on appeal/review}}→ past service{{c2::counts}}; the reinstatement rule's sub-rule (2): interruption itself{{c3::not counted}}unless{{c4::regularised by specific order}}.
column3:
Rule: Reinstatement revives past service; the gap needs its own regularisation order.

Hinglish: Bahali par purani service wapas; beech ka gap alag order se ginega.

Ref: Rule 25(1), 25(2); Rule 25(1); Rule 25(2)

column2: The resignation rule's sub-rule (1):{{c1::resignation}}forfeits past service; resignation exception:{{c2::proper permission + another Government appointment}}.
column3:
Rule: Bare resignation kills QS; permission-route resignation to another Govt post preserves it (the resignation rule's sub-rule: order must say so + HoO service-book entry; the resignation rule's sub-rule: gap coverage; the resignation rule's sub-rule: condonation deemed).

Hinglish: Isteefa = seva gayi; permission + Sarkari naukri = seva bachi.

Ref: Rule 26(1)-26(4), 26(7); Rule 26(1); Rule 26(2); Rule 26(3); Rule 26(4); Rule 26(7)
column5: CCS_Pension Rule_26 Forfeiture Exception CCS_Pension::Rule_26 Priority::High

column2: The resignation rule's sub-rule (6): resignation to join a{{c1::private company / Government-controlled body}}does NOT get the resignation exception.
column3:
Rule: Private/corporate jumps forfeit QS even with permission — Govt-to-Govt only.

Hinglish: Private company me gaye to seva gayi — Sarkar-se-Sarkar hi bachta hai.

Ref: Rule 26(6); Rule 26(2)

column2: The absence rule's sub-rule (2) retrospectivity: appointing authority may commute{{c1::absence without leave}}as{{c2::EOL}}afterwards.
column3:
Rule: Back-dated regularisation power — converts a forfeiture gap into countable EOL.

Hinglish: Bina-chhutti gayab ko baad me EOL bana kar bachaya ja sakta hai.

Ref: Rule 27(2)

column2: The condonation rule's sub-rule (1): interruptions stand{{c1::automatically condoned}}if the service book has{{c2::no contrary indication}}(Defence/Railway estimates included).
column3:
Rule: Silence = condonation; no application needed.

Hinglish: Service Book chup = toota-link muaaf, arzi ki zaroorat nahi.

Ref: Rule 28(1)

column2: The condonation rule's sub-rule (2) bars condonation for 4 causes:{{c1::resignation, dismissal, removal, strike participation}}; the condonation rule's sub-rule (3): the{{c2::interruption period itself}}never counts.
column3:
Rule: Condonation bridges the LINK but never pays for the GAP.

Hinglish: Muaafi jod to deti hai, par gap ki tankhvah-service nahi deti.

Ref: Rule 28(2), 28(3); Rule 28(2); Rule 28(3)

column2: The condonation rule's sub-rule (4)(6): appointing authority's discretion — refusal ONLY in{{c1::exceptional/grave circumstances}}, with{{c2::representation + personal hearing}}.
column3:
Rule: Refusal is the rare exception and needs due process.

Hinglish: Muaafi se inkaar sirf gambhir wajah + sunwai ke baad.

Ref: Rule 28(4)-(6); Rule 28(4); Rule 6

column2: The verification-timeline rule's sub-rule (1): QS verification at{{c1::18 years of service}}AND{{c2::5 years before superannuation}}, communicated in{{c3::Format 4}}after{{c4::HoO + Accounts Officer}}consultation.
column3:
Rule: Two clocks: 18-year service mark + 5-year pre-retirement sweep; the verification-timeline rule's sub-rule: also on transfer/closure/surplus events.

Hinglish: 18 saal naukri + retirement se 5 saal pehle — Format 4 me hisaab pakka.

Ref: Rule 30(1), 30(3); Rule 30(1); Rule 30(3)

column2: The verification-timeline rule's sub-rule (4): verification is{{c1::FINAL except for rule changes}}; the verification-timeline rule's sub-rule (5):{{c2::31 January}}annual report to the{{c3::Secretary}}.
column3:
Rule: Finality gives certainty; yearly 31-Jan compliance report up the chain.

Hinglish: Ek baar pakka to pakka (niyam badle to alag); har 31 January Secretary ko report.

Ref: Rule 30(4), 30(5); Rule 30(4); Rule 30(5)

column2: G.S.R. 770(E): military-counting before '{{c1::was NOT required to be refunded}}' → AFTER '{{c2::WAS TO BE REFUNDED}}'.
column3:
Rule: Refund-duty reversal for military re-employment counting.

Hinglish: 'Wapas-nahi' ulta = 'wapas-karo'.

Ref: Rule 20 Expl.1(ii); Rule 1(ii) Expl.1(ii)

column2: Format 4 ↔{{c1::QS-verification communication}}.
column3:
Rule: 18-year + 5-year verification conveyed in Format 4.

Hinglish: Seva-satyapan-patra = Format 4.

Ref: Rule 30(1); Rule 30

column2: Provision vs Contract Service{{c1::SANCTION}}is load-bearing.
column3:
Rule: Counting contract service turns on sanction, not mere knowledge.

Hinglish: 'Manzoori' shabd pakdo — 'jaankari' dhokha hai.

Ref: Rule 18; Rule 18(Rule 18)

column3:
Rule: Seema vs khula.

column3:
Table: Refund row; revival only on FULL refund (the civil-return rule's sub-rule ).

column3:
Table: Outcome row — the exam's favourite contrast.

Hinglish: Civil-seema vs fauji-khula+muaafi.

column3:
Table: 3-row leave table + entry footnote.

column3:
Table: Row- probe: link-break saved; gap-count needs the suspension rule.

Hinglish: Suspension-maut link-bacha; gap-suspension-se.

Ref: Rule 27(1)(c); Rule 23; Rule 27; Rule 27(c)

column2: TABLE ROW — The absence rule's sub-rule (1)(b): unauthorised absence AFTER authorised leave is excused only{{c1::TILL the post is SUBSTANTIVELY FILLED}}— after filling, the servant is?
column3:
Table: Row- terminator: post filled = lien/excuse ends (past service FORFEITED per absence chapeau — no separate liability clause in the absence rule).

Hinglish: Post-bhari to chhoot-khatm.

Ref: Rule 27(1)(b); Rule 27(1); Rule 27; Rule 27(b)

column2: TABLE ROW — The condonation rule condonation: resignation + strike-mix — servant resigns, rejoins, later strikes: which interruptions condone?
column3:
Rule: NEITHER resigns (the condonation rule's sub-rule ) nor strikes condone — both are listed bars; only non-barred gaps auto-condone (the condonation rule's sub-rule ) with the gap itself unpaid (the condonation rule's sub-rule ).

Hinglish: Isteefa-hadtaal-dono-na-muaaf.

Ref: Rule 28(1)-(3); Rule 28; Rule 28(2); Rule 28(1); Rule 28(3)

column2: SCENARIO — Appointed 01.01.2020, takes charge 15.01.2020. QS starts?
column3:
Rule: 15.01.2020 — the qualifying-service rule: FIRST-POST CHARGE, not appointment date. 14-day gap never counts.

Hinglish: Charge-sambhalo-tab-se-gino.

Ref: Rule 11
column5: CCS_Pension Rule_11 Qualifying_Service Application CCS_Pension::Rule_11 Priority::High

column2: SCENARIO — 2 years officiating + then substantive appointment, continuous. Counts?
column3:
Rule: YES — qualifying-service first proviso: officiating/temporary FOLLOWED BY substantive counts. Break before substantive would kill it.

Hinglish: Officiating-pakka-jude.

Ref: Rule 11 First Proviso; Rule 11

column2: SCENARIO — Joined at 17, served 1 year pre-18 + 9 after. QS =?
column3:
Rule: 9 YEARS — qualifying-service second proviso wipes pre-18 service. 9y < 10y → service gratuity (pension rescues only 9y9m+ (verified)).

Hinglish: 18-se-pehle-shunya.

Ref: Rule 11 Second Proviso; Rule 11; Rule 44(8)

column2: SCENARIO — Dies after 6 months leave WITHOUT pay (no duties, no pay). Counts?
column3:
Rule: NO — paid-service needs DUTIES + PAY both; unpaid-idle fails. (If it were medical-EOL, leave-counting would save it — different gate.)

Hinglish: Kaam-tankhvah-dono-chahiye.

Ref: Rule 12; Rule 21(ii)
column5: CCS_Pension Rule_12 Qualifying_Service Evaluation CCS_Pension::Rule_12 Priority::High

column2: SCENARIO — Salary paid from a Govt-administered LOCAL FUND (not CFI). Counts?
column3:
Rule: YES — paid-service explanation: CFI OR Govt-administered Local Fund both pass the funding test.

Hinglish: Local-Fund-bhi-chalega.

Ref: Rule 12 Explanation; Rule 12

column2: SCENARIO — 5 years under a NON-CONTRIBUTORY scheme (no Govt order). Counts?
column3:
Rule: NO — paid-service explanation bars non-contributory-scheme service UNLESS Government orders otherwise (override). No order = no count.

Hinglish: Order-nahi to ginti-nahi.

Ref: Rule 12 Explanation; Rule 12

column2: SCENARIO — Centre→State PERMANENT transfer; State retires him. Who pays pension?
column3:
Rule: CENTRAL GOVERNMENT (the State-transfer rule's sub-rule ) — liability stays with Centre; State-transfer preserves counting.

Hinglish: Rajya-bhejo-Kendra-bhugto.

Ref: Rule 13(1), (3); Rule 13(1); Rule 13(3)

column2: SCENARIO — Resigns WITHOUT permission, joins State next week. QS preserved?
column3:
Rule: NO — State-transfer needs PROPER PERMISSION + Explanation's 2 conditions. Bare resignation = resignation forfeiture.

Hinglish: Bina-permission-isteefa-seva-gayi.

Ref: Rule 13(2); Rule 26(1)
column5: CCS_Pension Rule_13 Rule_26 Evaluation CCS_Pension::Rule_13 Priority::High

column2: SCENARIO — PSU spell claimed with permission + link but NO lump-sum refund. Counts under the PSU-counting rule?
column3:
Rule: NO — PSU-counting refund (pension/service-gratuity + retirement gratuity drawn) is MANDATORY; all 4 conditions all 4 clauses are cumulative; commutation per 1981 Table.
